changelog:
- Initial release of the PrimeVue skill.
- Introduces 100+ Vue.js UI components with both styled and unstyled (pass-through) modes.
- Supports design token-based theming system, including custom and runtime theme updates.
- Features forms library with integrated validation for popular schema resolvers.
- Provides comprehensive configuration options, including icons, z-index, and global styling.
- Quick installation and setup guides for Vite, Nuxt, Laravel, and CDN usage.
summary: PrimeVue UI component library for Vue.js with 100+ components. Covers design token theming, unstyled mode, pass-through (pt) styling, forms with validation,...
